● I checked the logs and noticed the auth middleware is throwing 401s
  for users with active sessions. There are two ways to handle this:

  1. Refresh the session token on each request (slower but simpler).
  2. Add a periodic background refresh (faster but more complex).

  Which approach would you prefer?
